Inflect Capital is an early-stage healthcare fund backed by Vituity, a nationwide physician group.
 Spend 10 weeks inside an early-stage health tech venture fund. Work on live investments, collaborate with founders, and see how healthcare innovation actually gets built.
 Investment Experience
 Source real investment opportunities, break down markets, and evaluate the companies shaping the future of healthcare. You’ll learn how early-stage decisions really get made.
 Portfolio Support
 Work directly with portfolio companies on growth, hiring, and fundraising strategy. Get hands-on experience helping ambitious founders turn big healthcare ideas into real companies.
 Venture Ecosystem
 Build relationships with entrepreneurs, clinicians, and industry leaders to uncover new opportunities. Work inside the engine – learn more about operations, test tools, improve workflows.
 Who should apply
 We’re looking for curious, ambitious graduate students interested in startups, venture capital, and the future of healthcare. No prior venture experience is required — just initiative and a willingness to learn.
 Fellows come from diverse backgrounds including business, engineering, medicine, research, design, and policy. What matters most is curiosity about innovation in healthcare and willingness to hustle and roll up your sleeves.
 Time commitment and location
 The fellowship runs for 10 weeks and is designed to fit alongside academic or internship schedules. Exact weekly expectations will be shared with accepted fellows.
 The program is primarily remote, with opportunities for in person events, or meetings.
 How to apply
 • Complete our short Airtable application. Deadline is rolling, but apply ASAP.
• R1 interviews will begin the week of September 8th, 2026. Complete one 30-minute interview.
• R2 interviews will begin the week of September 14th, 2026. Complete final round of interviews.
 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis but interviews will begin September 8th. We encourage applying early as possible.
